notes: Shares cooldown with Ghost Scepter and its upgrades.
Ethereal units take -30% bonus magic damage.
abilities.description:
Converts the target unit to ethereal form, rendering them immune to physical damage, but unable to attack and -30% more vulnerable to magic damage.

Enemy targets are also slowed by -80%, and take 1x the sum of all your attributes + 50 as magical damage.
Duration: 4 seconds

additionalInformation: The item's attributes grants the following additional bonuses:
300 mana, 1.25 mana regeneration and 2.5% flat base magic resistance.
5, 5 and 25 main attack damage to all / / heroes respectively.
24.5 main attack damage to universal heroes.
name: Ethereal Blade
description: A flickering blade of a ghastly nature, it is capable of dealing damage in both magical and physical planes.
tips: Can be used in combination with Dagon for massive amounts of burst damage.
